parameters.query:
-- Dev uniquement : utilisateur de test pour lancer le workflow à la main
SELECT id AS user_id FROM users WHERE username = 'test_chris';

-- Pré-filtre : sujets suivis par l'utilisateur, news des dernières 48h,
-- jamais envoyées à cet utilisateur. Max 15 par sujet pour garder de la variété.
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT n.id, n.title, n.description, n.url, n.source, n.topic_slug, n.published_at,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY n.topic_slug ORDER BY n.published_at DESC) AS rk
  FROM news n
  JOIN user_topics ut ON ut.topic_slug = n.topic_slug AND ut.user_id = $1::uuid
  WHERE n.published_at > now() - interval '48 hours'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM newsletter_items ni
      JOIN newsletters nl ON nl.id = ni.newsletter_id
      WHERE nl.user_id = $1::uuid AND ni.news_id = n.id)
)
SELECT id, title, description, url, source, topic_slug, published_at
FROM ranked
WHERE rk <= 15
ORDER BY published_at DESC
LIMIT 40;
